Plan '''Beta-Three''' was a tactical maneuver used by [[Sabaoth Squadron/Legends|Sabaoth Squadron]] during the latter portion of the [[Battle of Nod Kartha]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. A combined fleet consisting of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] and [[Mere Resistance]] attacked a [[Trihexalon]] factory on [[Nod Kartha]]. The [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] came out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and engaged the [[Orbital Defense Cannon]]s before breaking through to the surface. After the factory was wiped out, Sabaoth Squadron reinforcements led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bella (Twi'lek)|Bella]] in the [[Reaver (Sabaoth destroyer)|''Reaver'']] arrived in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and began salvaging the wrecked cannons. When the resistance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] flew back to rendezvous with their [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], the ''[[Tritus]]'', the two fleets engaged one another. Bella ordered the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of one of the [[Sabaoth Frigate]]s to execute Plan Beta-Three, and three frigates jumped into hyperspace. While the resistance gathered cannon pieces to use for themselves, the three frigates jumped back into the battle and used their [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] to hold the ''Tritus'' in place. The frigates were ultimately destroyed, allowing the resistance to flee to their next [[Battle of Lok (22 BBY)|engagement]].

==Behind the scenes==
This tactical maneuver appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''.
